component.name: WeTypeX
component.summary: Use the WeType input engine with Fcitx 5

description.p: WeTypeX integrates the original WeType engine with Fcitx 5. It provides Chinese input, optional English completion, voice input, device sync, file transfer and an AI assistant.
The original runtime is downloaded from its official source after accepting the upstream license. It is kept in the application's private user data and is not included in this extension.
